Looking to build real visibility for your crypto exchange?

MediaX helps new and growing platforms get seen in the right places. Our PR service is designed for CEXs, DEXs, and token platforms that need credible coverage, fast. From writing to distribution, we take care of the entire process.

Why PR Is Important for Crypto Exchanges

Launching an exchange is no longer just about going live. In 2025, people want to see who’s behind the platform, where it’s being talked about, and why should they trust it. And that trust begins often with consistent media visibility.

  • Exchanges deal with issues like:
  • Not enough awareness after launch
  • No presence on known crypto sites
  • Investors asking for proof of credibility
  • Traffic that doesn’t convert because of weak trust
  • Lack of media mentions or verified coverage

Getting the right PR doesn’t just get your name out, it gives your project weight. When people see familiar outlets covering your exchange, they take you more seriously.

What’s Included in the Crypto Exchange PR Package

Custom PR Writing

We write the content for you. It’s shaped around your goals, whether you’re listing a token or opening a trading platform.

Crypto & Finance Distribution

Your release is sent to well-known outlets like Yahoo Finance, CoinTelegraph, and others that show up in search.

Media Planning for Launch Windows

If you're preparing for a token listing, beta launch, or major update, we help time your release for the right impact.

Influencer Add-On (Optional)

Want extra attention? We can include influencer reposts, especially on Twitter and YouTube, to expand your reach.

Compliance-Aware Copy

We review your messaging to make sure it doesn’t create risk in regulated areas. This is needed if you're offering KYC or token access.

What You Can Expect

  • Better first impressions with real media coverage
  • Improved search presence from links and mentions
  • More interest from token holders, traders, and VCs
  • A stronger launch when combined with social proof
  • More clicks from media sources that rank in Google

Results vary depending on the platform and goals but PR helps bring attention and credibility in a way that paid ads can’t match in most of the cases.

Let’s Publish Your Story

You’ve built something valuable, now it’s time people see it.

We’re here to help crypto exchanges pr gain coverage that matters. Whether you’re weeks away from launch or already live, we can support your campaign.

Submit your press release today or talk to us if you'd like help shaping your announcement.

FAQs

1) Can I choose which sites the PR goes to?

You’ll get a fixed list of publications before launch. We select sites that are relevant and verified. Some placements are guaranteed, and some are optional add-ons.

2) Will this help with SEO?

Yes, especially if you combine this with link-building or influencer campaigns. Press mentions help your brand appear in searches.

After approval, most releases are published in 2–3 business days. We also offer faster delivery options if needed.
